_comment: Mock Notion-shape employee dataset. Match the shape your Apps Script proxy returns so the same fetchNotionEmployeeData() consumer code works for both. Keys are flat; the proxy's job is to flatten Notion's nested page properties down to this shape.

_schema.id: EMP-XXX — matches employees.emp_id in Supabase; used as the lookup key.
_schema.photoUrl: Direct URL to a Notion-hosted or S3-hosted photo. null = use gradient fallback with initials.
_schema.nick: Korean nickname shown left-of-parens on the profile card (e.g. '나나').
_schema.name: Uppercase Latin display name shown inside the parens on the profile card (e.g. 'TANG MOUYCHENG').
_schema.fullName: Full bilingual 성명 string used in the [기본정보] section (e.g. '땅 무이쨍(Tang Mouycheng)'). Falls back to nick(name) if absent.
_schema.role: Job title line shown on its own row under the name on the profile card (e.g. 'Software Engineer II').
_schema.gender: 여 | 남 (single-char per the Notion screenshot).
_schema.languages: Array of strings — each entry is one language with optional level in parens, e.g. '영어(비즈니스)'.
_schema.certificates: Array of certificate names — joined with comma in the rendered paragraph.
_schema.techExperience: Array of bullet strings — rendered as a native <ul> with disc bullets.
_schema.files: Array of {name, url, type, size?} — resume / certificates. `size` is a display string like '4.8 MiB' or '512 KB'.
